name: Cheesy Penne with Zucchini, Corn & Basil

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Once the pasta is finished, drain and return to pot and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
510 g penne pasta
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onions and garlic to the pot, stirring frequently, cook until slightly softened, 3-4 minutes.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
3 small pkgs fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Add the frozen corn to the pot, stirring frequently, cook until slightly softened, 3-4 minutes.
Trim zucchinis; halve lengthwise and cut crosswise into thin half moons.
Add the zucchinis and spices to the pot. Increase heat to medium-high and sauté, stirring frequently, until the vegetables are soft and golden, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
1 ½ tsp oregano
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; set aside.
Reduce the heat to low and stir the tomato sauce into the pot, simmer for 3-4 minutes.

instructions.secondary_message:
85 g Parmesan cheese
1 (227 g) block mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add the sauce and veggies to the pot with the cooked pasta, along with the Parmesan, mozzarella, and fresh basil (reserving a small amount for garnish); stir to combine.
To serve, divide between plates and garnish with reserved basil; enjoy!
